_what: Project-scoped exclusions. A record listed here is barred from one project's retrieval — never from the vault, and never from other projects.
_precedence: ABSOLUTE. An exclusion is applied before ranking and outranks rating, compositional-operation relevance and sector relevance. No axis can return an excluded record, including any axis added later.
_scope: Keyed by brief slug — the basename of projects/requests/<slug>.txt and projects/briefs/<slug>.md.
_visibility: brief.mjs prints every applied exclusion and writes it into the compiled brief. An exclusion never removes a record silently.
_not_this_file: A record Alex judges globally wrong belongs in vault/sites.json as dialectStatus out, with its reasoning. This file is only for 'not on this project'.

patton-motors.reason: Explicitly excluded from Patton Motors. It entered the compiled brief by accident and must not be used as evidence, direction, compositional source or retrieval candidate for this project.
